name: M31A Architecture Constitution & Consolidation Specification
verdict_justification: M31A contains a robust, verified downstream agentic coding engine passing live model tests against NVIDIA NIM endpoints, but is critically bifurcated from upstream Genesis planning, throttled by a hardcoded single-task prompt constraint, vulnerable to a P0 filesystem bypass on .git and .m31a, and burdened by quadruple DAG duplication, five competing artifact representations, and a synthetic file-check step executor.

principles.name: The model proposes. The runtime decides.
principles.description: The LLM is an untrusted probabilistic reasoning component. Model outputs are proposals. The runtime deterministically validates, authorizes, schedules, executes, and verifies all actions.

principles.name: Single Crate Architecture
principles.description: M31A is a single Rust crate (m31a). No Cargo workspaces or auxiliary crates are permitted.

principles.name: Rust Only for Core
principles.description: Zero runtime dependencies on Node.js, Python, or GPU libraries on the host system. Core runtime remains pure native Rust.

principles.name: Every Side Effect Passes Through Policy
principles.description: No tool call, subagent, internal routine, or workflow step may execute a side effect without passing through EffectivePolicy evaluation.

principles.name: TUI is a Projection, Never Authoritative State
principles.description: The terminal user interface is a read-only projection and interactive control surface. It never stores durable state.

principles.name: Never Fake Success
principles.description: Placeholder functions, silent mock returns, synthetic success stubs (such as checking file presence rather than executing work), and TODO-only implementations are strictly prohibited.

principles.name: Completion Requires Evidence
principles.description: No task, mission, or workflow step is marked complete without deterministic, verifiable evidence (test suite pass, compiler exit code 0, artifact content hash verification).

principles.name: Bounded Retries Only
principles.description: Unbounded loops and indefinite retries are prohibited. All loops must be constrained by BudgetEnforcer and detected by LoopDetector.

principles.name: Cancellation is Real
principles.description: Every asynchronous operation, worker task, model query, and process execution must respect CancellationToken and cleanly abort on SIGINT/SIGTERM.

principles.name: External Data is Untrusted
principles.description: Repository content, web research data, user inputs, and LLM responses are treated as untrusted data subject to schema validation and security boundaries.

principles.name: Strongly Typed Domain Boundaries
principles.description: Prefer strongly typed Rust domain IDs (MissionId, TaskId, AgentId, WorkflowRunId) and typed enums over raw strings.

layers.name: Kernel & Persistence Primitives
layers.responsibilities: Domain UUIDv7 identifiers, sqlx SQLite pool, schema migrations (001-013), FsArtifactStore blob storage.

layers.name: Security, Policy & Configuration
layers.responsibilities: ResolvedConfiguration, EffectivePolicy, command blacklists, path component security (.git/.m31a rejection), InteractiveGate approvals.

layers.name: Capabilities, Process Sandbox & Git
layers.responsibilities: Tool execution pipeline, Bubblewrap process isolation (ProcessSandbox), Git worktree manager (WorktreeManager), commit attribution trailers.

layers.name: Intelligence, Models & Context
layers.responsibilities: ModelProvider (NvidiaProvider), ModelGateway, AST repository scanner, ContextCompiler, TokenBudgeter.

layers.name: Agent Runtime & Prompts
layers.responsibilities: AgentRunner, specialist agent profiles (Coder, Reviewer, Verifier), Minijinja PromptCatalog, reasoning loop.

layers.name: Planning, DAG & Scheduling
layers.responsibilities: PlanService task decomposition (1..N), generic DirectedAcyclicGraph algorithms, SchedulerEngine wave queues, worker pool concurrency.

layers.name: Orchestration, Workflow & Genesis
layers.responsibilities: AutonomyController 12-stage closed execution loop, WorkflowEngine manifest runner, quality gates, Project Genesis synthesizers.

layers.name: Composition Root
layers.responsibilities: AppRuntime: runtime bootstrapping, pool management, migrations, event bus, crash recovery scanner, graceful cancellation.

layers.name: Presentation & Control
layers.responsibilities: Clap CLI subcommands, Ratatui interactive cockpit, UniversalCommandPalette v2.

forbidden_alternatives: Direct LLM task decomposition without requirement grounding
Ad-hoc agent architectural changes during coding
Unrecorded architectural changes in git commits
Direct scheduler execution of roadmap markdown
In-memory oneshot channels without DB ledger rows
Model claims of success without test output

initialization: Verify workspace root and validate Git repository
Initialize SQLite pool (sqlx::SqlitePool) with WAL mode and busy_timeout=5000
Run StartupCrashRecoveryScanner to reconcile abandoned in-flight tasks and reset states
Assemble EffectivePolicy, WorktreeManager, BudgetEnforcer, and ControllerDependencies
shutdown: Trigger CancellationToken to halt background worker loops
Wait for in-flight transactions to commit or roll back
Prune clean worktrees from disk via WorktreeManager
forbidden_ownership: Interactive UI rendering and layout calculations

domains.execution_authority: WorkflowEngine lowers steps into Missions; does not act as thread pool scheduler.

domains.role: Durable unit of autonomous software engineering execution
domains.execution_authority: AutonomyController executes 12-stage closed loop, budget tracking, loop recovery.
Executed by AgentRunner inside isolated Git worktree; verified by EvidenceCompletionGate.

domains.role: Runtime admission, wave progression, worker concurrency
domains.execution_authority: SchedulerEngine admits Wave N tasks to bounded worker pool (max concurrency: 4).

domains.role: Specialist persona driving prompt-reason-tool reasoning loop
domains.execution_authority: AgentRunner configured with AgentProfile, PromptContract, and ModelTier.

domains.role: Interactive conversational continuity across TUI/CLI turns
domains.execution_authority: SessionManager backed by SQLite sessions and conversation_messages tables.

domains.role: Non-bypassable boundary policy and sandbox isolation
domains.execution_authority: EffectivePolicy intercepts all requests; ProcessSandbox isolates execution.
EvidenceCompletionGate requires real test/compiler exit codes before completion.

storage.physical_medium: SQLite Database (.m31a/m31a.db WAL mode via sqlx)
storage.lifecycle: ACID transactions; retained across all missions; WAL checkpointed
Content-addressed; immutable once written; pruned on explicit gc
Projections generated by Genesis synthesizers; versioned in Git
Mutations isolated in .m31a/worktrees/; merged on verification pass
Append-only; secret-redacted; rotated by file size

security_boundaries.rule: Paths escaping workspace root must be rejected immediately.
Any tool path containing '.m31a' component must be rejected with SecurityViolation.
Any tool path containing '.git' component must be rejected with SecurityViolation.
Processes execute with read-only system mounts, isolated tmpfs, and purged env vars.
Blocks rm -rf /, mkfs, dd, fork bombs, and curl piped to bash.
Scrubs nvapi-*, sk-*, and ghp_* tokens prior to writing logs or model prompts.

Migrate all system prompts and planning instructions into Minijinja templates.
Require all generated artifacts to be hashed, stored in blob storage, and indexed in SQLite.

deferred.reason: 28 native tools already cover operations; process isolation is solved via Bubblewrap.
M31A is an autonomous engineering workstation tool; local Tokio worker pool is optimal.
SQLite WAL mode with sqlx provides zero-configuration local ACID persistence.
Premature. Core runtime and Genesis handoff must be consolidated first.

prohibitions.reason: All concurrency, worker pools, and wave queues belong exclusively to SchedulerEngine.

prohibitions.prohibition: NEVER build a second composition root
prohibitions.reason: All production services and persistence pools must be assembled by AppRuntime.

prohibitions.prohibition: NEVER build a parallel session store
prohibitions.reason: Interactive chat sessions reside in SQLite sessions and conversation_messages.
Every tool call and side effect must traverse EffectivePolicy.
No LLM response may alter policy rules or approve security gates.
No placeholder functions, silent mock returns, or synthetic file-check completions.

prohibitions.prohibition: NEVER treat unvalidated Markdown as operational state
prohibitions.reason: Operational state must reside in SQLite with strongly typed enums.
